## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or adjusted (a bug fix comes with a test that fails without the fix)

- [ ] Documentation updated in both languages if behaviour changed (`README.md` / `README.de.md`)
- [ ] No real data (passwords, domain/server names, IP addresses, user names)
- [ ] Commits signed off (`git commit -s`) – I agree to publish this under AGPL-3.0-or-later
